content: {"like": ["classic 1937 version with freshness and timeless appeal", "excellent editing and flawless pacing with no wasted moments", "uplifting final scene at Grauman's Chinese Theatre", "comic interludes and optimistic enthusiasm balancing the tragedy", "overacting that works and elicits empathy for Janet Gaynor’s character", "high-quality transfers such as Image DVD, Kino DVD, and Kino VHS", "complete and well-preserved opening scene with Selznick Studios fanfare and Max Steiner music"], "dislike": ["musical versions (1954 and 1976) being disappointing compared to the 1937 drama", "presence of \"corn\" in scenes with Andy Devine and Janet Gaynor’s naivete", "some overacting that feels excessive", "certain transfers missing part or all of the opening scene"]}
